description: A banner three storeys tall unrolled down the face of a gutted storefront, so bright it seems to hum. A crowd of identical smiling owners raise identical branded mugs toward a sunrise that is mostly logo. BE SOMEBODY. FRANCHISE THE FUTURE. Underneath, in loyalty-program cursive: "From nobody to name-brand. Your Corp, your colours, your corner of a city that respects exactly one thing — results."
name: a towering Franchise recruitment banner
